did_you_know.title: Abolitionist Frederick Douglass delivers his "What to the Slave Is the Fourth of…
did_you_know.text: Abolitionist Frederick Douglass delivers his "What to the Slave Is the Fourth of July?" speech at a meeting organized by the Rochester Ladies' Anti-Slavery Society in Rochester, New York.

did_you_know.title: New York State Abolishes Slavery
did_you_know.text: New York State's Emancipation Act took full effect on July 4, 1827, freeing all enslaved people in the state — including Sojourner Truth, who had been freed a year earlier.
